generation_notes: Four full candidate seeds were built from the supplied EtherNet/IP encapsulation and CPF rules plus issue summaries. Each seed preserves a 24-byte encapsulation header with little-endian command and payload length, uses documented CPF item type IDs, and varies between SendUnitData connected-style parsing, SendRRData unconnected parsing, and explicit-message Connection Manager style service traffic. Where CIP path layout details were not explicitly provided in sources, compact commonly used encodings were used as conservative inferred assumptions and marked as such. Session-dependent sequences begin with RegisterSession and reuse the returned session handle as an inferred runtime substitution point; placeholder handle 01000000 is used in static seed bytes.
